intro.h2: A cabinet company that sits down and plans the kitchen with you
paragraphs: The Kitchen Connection LLC. designs and installs Farmington kitchen cabinets from a home office on Grey Fox, by appointment. In January 2025 the business started its 32nd year in the Farmington area, and its Facebook page counts more than 1,600 kitchens for builders and homeowners.

Reviewers keep coming back to the same thing: patience with choices. Jeramie walks people through layout and cabinet options, door styles and colors such as Koch & Company's Pecan knotty alder or Fog, and then installs what they picked, so the person who drew the plan is the one fitting the boxes. Customers mention the demo, the dishwasher hookup and the boxes hauled away at the end.

services.h2: Farmington kitchen cabinets and the work around them

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinet design
items.blurb: Bring your measurements or your plans and work through layout, door style and finish together. Recent kitchens use Koch & Company's Seneca and Liberty door styles in colors like Pecan knotty alder and Fog. Ten Google reviews mention help with cabinet choices.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with a navy island featuring an X-panel end and a stone countertop

items.name: Cabinet installation
items.blurb: The same team that helps you design the kitchen puts it in. Reviewers describe the old cabinets being torn out, every new cabinet set and fitted, appliances like a dishwasher reconnected, and empty boxes hauled off before they leave.

image.alt: Knotty alder cabinets in a pecan stain with a tall pantry unit and granite countertops

items.name: Islands and full kitchen remodels
items.blurb: Some jobs are one island, others move walls. A 2026 post shows a clunky island turned into a seating island with quartz. A 2022 remodel removed walls, moved appliances and added a large custom island and a beverage bar.

image.alt: White kitchen with a large granite-topped island on turned legs and a dark painted base

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Countertops are part of the kitchen plan, so the cabinet layout and the top are chosen together. Project photos show quartz on islands and granite on perimeter cabinets, with tile backsplashes finished around them. Picking both at once keeps colors and edges working together.

image.alt: Large white quartz island with painted cabinets and a mosaic tile backsplash along the wall

items.name: Pantry, laundry and bath cabinets
items.blurb: Google reviews mention pantry cabinets, laundry room cabinets and bathroom remodels as well as kitchens. Inside the boxes, pull-out organizers keep pans and lids standing up instead of stacked, so the storage works as well as it looks.

image.alt: Pull-out wire organizer holding pans and lids inside a rustic wood base cabinet

items.name: Bars and beverage centers
items.blurb: Cabinets are not only for the kitchen. Photos include a basement bar with green cabinets, a long stone-faced counter and seating, and the 2022 remodel added a beverage bar beside the new island. A bar can be planned with the same door style as the kitchen.

image.alt: Basement bar with dark green cabinets, stacked stone backsplash and front, white counter and bar stools

process.h2: From first call to finished kitchen

steps.title: Call to set up an appointment
steps.text: The office is in a home, so call (573) 701-5101 first to set a time to meet and look at ideas.

steps.title: Talk through layout and options
steps.text: Go over layout, door styles, colors and storage. Reviewers say the options are explained patiently until you are sure.

steps.title: Demo and installation
steps.text: The old cabinets come out and the new ones go in. Customers are told when the crew is arriving and what to expect.

steps.title: Hookups, cleanup and walkthrough
steps.text: Appliances like the dishwasher are reconnected and checked, empty boxes are hauled away, and you walk the finished kitchen together.

items.name: Cathy H.
items.text: The Kitchen Connection did an amazing job transforming my kitchen.  Jeramie was very understanding and patient while explaining all the different options for layout and cabinet choices.  He was so great at  communicating with me regarding all aspects of the project.  He exceeded my expectations in the time the job was completed in and his clean up after.  I love my new kitchen and would highly recommend The Kitchen Connection!

items.name: Shanna B.
items.text:
We recently completed a kitchen addition and hired Jeramie to design and install our kitchen cabinets, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, he was professional, reliable, and detail-oriented. The cabinet installation was done with great craftsmanship, and everything fits perfectly and looks beautiful.

His communication throughout the project was great, and any questions or small adjustments we had were handled quickly and professionally. Our new kitchen turned out even better than we imagined, and the cabinets are truly the centerpiece of the space.

We highly recommend The Kitchen Connection to anyone looking for quality cabinet installation and excellent customer service.

items.name: Wilma A.
items.text:
The Kitchen Connection LLC in Farmington is the best ever to install cabinets in your kitchen if you are interested in updating , remodeling or building a home .
I googled back in December just to get information, and I got an immediate response the next day by email to come and view some ideas. We chose the color ‘Pecan’ with knotty wood , and it turned out just fabulous! There are so many colors and options to choose from, and they will help you in making your decision.

Jeremy and his son, did the demo for me and installed all my new cabinets. They are honest , hard working folks . So friendly, easy to talk with , easy to discuss what options you choose and go over any difficulties that needed taken care of during installation. He also installed my new dishwasher and made absolutely sure everything was fantastically working .
They let you know when they are arriving , the expectation of everything you need to know about your kitchen . They hauled off empty boxes ,
I would highly the recommend ‘The Kitchen Connection ‘ in Farmington .
You will love it , when completed. We love our new kitchen. So happy we chose The Kitchen Connection’. They are the BEST !!

service_area.h2: Serving Farmington, Missouri and the surrounding area
service_area.text: The Kitchen Connection LLC. is based at 720 Grey Fox in Farmington, Missouri, and has worked in the Farmington area for more than 30 years. It builds custom kitchens for homeowners remodeling or building and for local builders. Appointments are held at the home office, so please call ahead. If you live outside Farmington and want to know whether your project is in range, call (573) 701-5101 and ask.

items.a: Yes. The Kitchen Connection LLC. runs from a home office at 720 Grey Fox in Farmington, and its Google listing asks you to call first to set up an appointment. Call (573) 701-5101 and pick a time to sit down and look at layouts, door styles and colors.

Google lists Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 12:30 PM to 5 PM. The office is closed on Sunday. Because it is a home office, call ahead even during those hours so someone is there to meet you.

items.q: What cabinet lines do you offer?
items.a: Recent kitchens use Koch & Company cabinets, including the Seneca and Liberty door styles and colors such as Pecan on knotty alder and Fog. Customers say there are many colors and options to choose from and that the team helps them decide which fits the room.

items.q: Do you install the cabinets too?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers describe the same team designing and installing their cabinets, doing the demo of the old kitchen, reconnecting a dishwasher, cleaning up and hauling away the empty boxes. One customer says the job was done faster than she expected, with a good clean up.

items.q: Do you work with builders on new homes?
items.a: Yes. The Facebook page says The Kitchen Connection LLC. provides custom kitchens for builders and homeowners. One reviewer used them for cabinets in a kitchen addition, and another reviewer recommends them to anyone updating, remodeling or building a home in Farmington.

final_cta.h2: Ready to plan your new kitchen?
final_cta.text: Call to set up a time at the Farmington office and start with the layout.
